prompt: Frank Jevons was the 9th Master of Hatfield College. His death came how many years after the death of his predecessor in the same role?
answer: Frank Jevons died in **1936**, while his predecessor, **George William Kitchin**, died in **1912**. Therefore, Jevons died **24 years after his predecessor**.
